what: The CRATE-LEVEL interning ids this body's aggregate types carry in the emitted artifact, keyed by the canonical FIRST-USE index the core module uses.
why: The FIRST chained body whose constant is an AGGREGATE containing a PhantomData marker, and the caller that the 2026-09-16 `IRConst.phantomdata` extension exists for. Reader A refuses this body outright without that constructor ("no Clean IRConst image for PhantomData"), so the extension is not a capability without a caller: this is the caller, and it is a body of TypeChecker::infer_type's derived closure.
how_it_is_used: `ir_mint::mint` reads the enums lane to mint the type alias; `ir_mint::project` reads the `interface` block in the other direction and REFUSES a fixture whose header or parameter types are not the pinned ones.
interface_what: The artifact facts the CORE MODULE cannot hold and the emitted text does print.
interface_producer_invariance: `ty` is the CANONICAL form; `observed_ty` is the verbatim token and is RECORDED, NEVER COMPARED.

interface.header_note: No calling-convention keyword, like every sidecar-lane body and unlike every crate-module one. Reader A records `artifact_calling_conv: ccc`.
interface.functy_note: Pinned VERBATIM from the emitted header `(functy.350)`; reader A independently records `artifact_functy_id: 350`.
interface.producer_note: The sidecar bundle's own producer stamp.

params.note: The output value of a `Try` whose Output is the unit type. Taken and IGNORED -- the body's answer does not depend on it, which is what makes this a two-node body.

interface.params_note: ONE, of unit type, and unused. A twin that returned its argument instead of a constant would differ from this body here and in the ret.
interface.aligns_note: EMPTY, and a measurement: no memory instruction in this body.
interface.clauses_note: Two kinds; the absence of `loc` and `names` is part of the pin.

enums.note: THE RETURN TYPE. The constant the body builds is `{ 0, phantomdata }` at this type -- tag 0 (Continue) and a zero-sized payload, which is exactly why the PhantomData image is load-bearing here rather than decorative.

funcs_note: EMPTY, and a measurement: this body calls nothing. Reader A's `crate_func_ids_seen` is the single entry [331], the body's own id.
